shortlist.label: Pilomatrixoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical description of a firm, cutaneous nodule with a chalky-white cut surface

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with a gradually enlarging, protuberant tumor

shortlist.label: Cylindroma
shortlist.why_kept: possible given the multilocular spaces and solid tumor on pathological examination

shortlist.label: Trichoepithelioma
shortlist.why_kept: considered due to the presence of a cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule

shortlist.label: Keratoacanthoma
shortlist.why_kept: a possible diagnosis given the rapid growth and cutaneous location of the tumor

raw.rationale: The presence of a firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor, multilocular spaces below the epidermis, and a solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance on pathological examination are characteristic of pilomatricoma. Additionally, the basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis are typical histological features of pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Calcifying Epithelioma of Malherbe
rejected.why: While it is another name for pilomatricoma, the provided shortlist includes Pilomatricoma as a separate option, making it the preferred choice.

rejected.label: Pilomatrixoma
rejected.why: It is a synonym for pilomatricoma, and pilomatricoma is the preferred term in this context.

rejected.label: Dermatofibroma
rejected.why: It typically presents as a firm, brownish to purple-colored nodule, which does not match the description of the tumor in the vignette.

rejected.label: Keratoacanthoma
rejected.why: It usually presents as a solitary, firm, and dome-shaped nodule with a central crater-like depression, which is not consistent with the description provided.
